SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000596
DOCKET NO. F01099425
PLAINTIFF – PENNYMAC LOAN SERVICES, LLC
DEFENDANTS- LANGSTON A GOODWINE; MARYANN LAURENCELL
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 15th DAY OF April 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of ELIZABETH, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 28 BLOCK 297
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1111 1/2 HAMPTON PLACE ELIZABETH, NJ 07201
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: UPSET PRICE: Approximately: $376,264.35 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
OCCUPANCY STATUS: Unknown
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Madison Avenue
Beginning in the northeasterly sideline of Hampton Place (50' R.O.W. as per Tax Map), distant 133.70' northwesterly along same from the westerly sideline of Madison Avenue (width varies as per Tax Map) and running thence; (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 03/05/2026; 2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $1 ,508.09 OPEN. Water Acct: 55-0007889-3 To: 02/20/2026 $236.18 OPEN PLUS PENALTY Subject to final reading, Additional accounts may exist; Please have seller provide evidence of all service at closing. Sewer: Included in Water Account(s). For sale information, please visit Auction.com at www.Auction.com or call (800) 280.2832.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff of other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
THE SHERIFF RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $348,578.30 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: March 23, 2026
FRENKEL LAMBERT WEISS WEISMAN & GORDON, LLP
53 GIBSON STREET
BAY SHORE, NY 11706
